title: P2 chat.bind: request
description: The operator binds a group chat to a tenant with a class ceiling; a ceiling above summary and cards in the group only for a driver with membership_assurance: enforced (DLV-7, REP-7).

assistant.description: Binding of a personal assistant; only a direct chat (DSP-10).

credentials_ref.description: Deprecated, not used; the field remains by MAN-3. The P2 secret of a channel is one per driver in the tenant, the answer of worker.enroll of the channel process issues it (p2_token, D-87 (3)).

notice_repeat.description: Binding setting: how often code repeats the ai_notice and privacy_notice notices in response to an activity from a non-principal in this chat, per pair (chat, identity); by default 90 days (MSG-17).

max_per_hour.description: Digests per hour; 1 for a group and 4 for a private chat by default.

digest.description: From v0.2: digest pace of the binding (REP-10).

locale.description: From v0.2: digest language of the binding (REP-10).

model_text.description: From v0.2: summary_only by default; labeled lets a marked model paragraph into a group chat (DLV-15, REP-2).
